turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to ride a century one day. Is that just a hundred miles?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly, a hundred miles in one ride. Some people also do a metric century, which is a hundred kilometers.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long would that take me?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: At an average of fifteen miles an hour, about seven hours of riding, plus stops.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It is. Most people start early, plan a couple of cafe stops, and finish by late afternoon.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great first goal. It's a big achievement on its own and builds you up for the full hundred.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I train for it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Build up your longest ride gradually, add about ten percent each week, and include an easy week every month.
